questions.stem: 研究顯示，由於少子化，鄉下學校的學生人數正在逐年減少。
questions.answer: Studies show that because of the low birth rate, the number of students in rural schools is decreasing every year.
accepted_answers: Research shows that due to the falling birth rate, the number of students at rural schools is dropping year by year.
Studies have shown that because of the declining birth rate, the number of students in country schools is getting smaller every year.

patterns: that 引導的名詞子句（當 show 的受詞）
現在進行式描述趨勢（is decreasing）

questions.stem: 一些曾經有上百名學生的鄉下學校，已經和鄰近的學校合併了。
questions.answer: Some rural schools that once had hundreds of students have already merged with nearby schools.
accepted_answers: Some country schools which used to have over a hundred students have already been combined with nearby schools.
Some rural schools that used to have hundreds of students have now merged with schools nearby.

patterns: 關係代名詞引導的形容詞子句（that／which）

1.explanation_zh: 「研究顯示」後面接一整句話，用 that 子句當受詞：Studies show that …（research 不可數，要說 Research shows that …）。「少子化」是出生率低：because of／due to the low birth rate。「鄉下學校的學生人數」改成後位修飾：the number of students in rural schools；主詞是 the number，動詞用單數。「正在逐年減少」是正在發生的趨勢，用現在進行式 is decreasing every year／year by year。
evidence: 鄉下學校的學生人數正在逐年減少
1.strategy_zh: the number of＋複數名詞 當主詞時動詞用單數；a number of＋複數名詞（許多…）才用複數動詞。
hints: 切成四段：研究顯示／由於少子化／鄉下學校的學生人數／正在逐年減少
標的詞彙：study（研究）、birth rate（出生率）、rural（鄉下的）、number（數目）、decrease（減少）
句型框架：Studies show that + S + is + V-ing …（趨勢用現在進行式）

2.explanation_zh: 主詞是「一些…的鄉下學校」，英文先寫 Some rural schools，再用關係代名詞 that／which 引導形容詞子句 that once had hundreds of students；「曾經」是過去，子句用 had（或 used to have）。主要子句「已經和鄰近的學校合併了」用現在完成式 have already merged with nearby schools（主詞複數，用 have）。
evidence: 曾經有上百名學生的鄉下學校
已經和鄰近的學校合併了
2.strategy_zh: 一句裡同時有「曾經」和「已經」時要分清楚：關係子句講過去的狀態用過去式，主要子句講到現在的結果用現在完成式。
hints: 切成四段：曾經有上百名學生的／鄉下學校／已經／和鄰近的學校合併了
標的詞彙：rural（鄉下的）、hundred（百）、merge（合併）、nearby（附近的）
句型框架：Some + N + that + V(過去式) … + have already + p.p. …

references: Studies show that because of the low birth rate, the number of students in rural schools is decreasing every year.
Research shows that due to the falling birth rate, the number of students at rural schools is dropping year by year.
Studies have shown that because of the declining birth rate, the number of students in country schools is getting smaller every year.

現在進行式描述趨勢（is decreasing）

common_errors.explanation_zh: research 是不可數名詞，動詞用單數 shows；studies 才用 show。
research 不可數，不加 a；可數的「一項研究」用 a study。

due to the falling birth rate
because of the declining birth rate
due to the low birth rate
because of the falling birth rate
as a result of the low birth rate

common_errors.explanation_zh: 「少子化」是出生率低，譯成 the low／falling birth rate；而且 child 是可數名詞，「較少的」要用 fewer。

common_errors.right: because of the low birth rate
common_errors.explanation_zh: because 後面接子句；接名詞片語要用 because of 或 due to。

accepted: the number of students in rural schools
the number of students at rural schools
the number of students in country schools
the number of students in schools in the countryside
the student population in rural schools

common_errors.right: the number of students in rural schools
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「…的學生人數」英文用 the number of students in …，修飾語放在後面。
students 是可數名詞，「人數」用 number。
主詞是 the number（人數），動詞用單數 is。
reduce 是及物動詞（減少某物），「人數自己減少」用 decrease、drop 或 fall。

traps.explanation_zh: 「少子化」是抽象名詞，要說出它的意思：the low／falling birth rate。

traps.literal_error: rural schools' students number are decreasing
traps.explanation_zh: 「…的學生人數」改成 the number of students in rural schools；主詞是 the number，動詞用單數。

bonus.text: Studies show that, with the birth rate falling, rural schools are seeing fewer and fewer students every year.
bonus.explanation_zh: 用 with＋名詞＋V-ing 表示附帶狀況，再用 fewer and fewer 表示「越來越少」，句子更精簡，屬加分寫法。

1.restructuring_zh: 「鄉下學校的學生人數」要改寫成 the number of students in rural schools（修飾語後置），主詞是單數的 the number，所以動詞用 is decreasing；抽象名詞「少子化」也要說成 the low birth rate。

Some country schools which used to have over a hundred students have already been combined with nearby schools.
Some rural schools that used to have hundreds of students have now merged with schools nearby.

common_errors.wrong: that once have hundreds of students
common_errors.right: that once had hundreds of students
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「曾經」是過去的事，子句動詞用過去式 had（或 used to have）。
some 後面接可數名詞時用複數。

common_errors.wrong: Some once had hundreds of students rural schools
common_errors.right: Some rural schools that once had hundreds of students
common_errors.explanation_zh: 中文的前置修飾在英文要改成名詞後面的關係子句。
「已經…了」表示完成並影響到現在，用現在完成式 have＋p.p.。
主詞 some rural schools 是複數，用 have。
「和…合併」是 merge with …（或 be combined with …）。

traps.zh: 曾經有上百名學生的鄉下學校
traps.literal_error: Some once had hundreds of students rural schools have already merged …
traps.explanation_zh: 「曾經有上百名學生的」是很長的前置修飾，英文要改成關係子句放在名詞後面：rural schools that once had hundreds of students。

traps.literal_error: Some rural schools already merged with nearby schools.
traps.explanation_zh: 「已經…了」要用現在完成式 have already merged。

2.restructuring_zh: 「曾經有上百名學生的鄉下學校」是長的前置修飾，英文要把名詞 rural schools 放前面，再用關係子句 that once had hundreds of students 修飾；子句的「曾經」用過去式，主要子句的「已經…了」用現在完成式。

1.translation: Studies show that because of the declining birth rate, the number of students in rural schools is decreasing year by year.
1.explanation_zh: 「研究顯示」用 Studies show that 名詞子句；「由於少子化」用 because of the declining birth rate；「正在逐年減少」用現在進行式 is decreasing year by year；主詞 the number of students 是單數，動詞用 is。

2.translation: Some rural schools that once had more than a hundred students have already merged with nearby schools.
2.explanation_zh: 「曾經有上百名學生的」用限定關係子句 that once had …；「上百名」譯 more than a hundred（hundreds of 會誇大）；「已經……合併了」用現在完成式 have already merged with。

issues_zh: （小建議，不影響判定）「上百名」較精確是 more than a hundred／over a hundred；首選 hundreds of 略有誇大但屬常見譯法，P1 也已收 more than a hundred。

1.translation: Research shows that, owing to the declining birth rate, the number of students in rural schools is decreasing year by year.
1.explanation_zh: 「研究顯示」用 Research shows that 帶出名詞子句；「由於少子化」譯為 owing to the declining birth rate；「學生人數」要用 the number of students 搭配單數動詞；「正在逐年減少」用現在進行式加 year by year。

2.translation: Some rural schools that once had hundreds of students have already merged with nearby schools.
2.explanation_zh: 「曾經有上百名學生」用 once had（或 used to have）修飾 schools；「上百名」我取 hundreds of，語意略有彈性（也可能是一百多人）；「已經…合併了」用現在完成式 have already merged with。

issues_zh: 備註：我用 owing to the declining birth rate，意思與 because of／due to 相同，但不在 part 2 的 accepted 清單；視為可接受，建議補進 owing to／thanks to 之類的換法。

第 3 部分「已經」只有兩個字，accepted 全部要求出現 already／now／recently；而 have 在第 3 部分、merged 在第 4 部分，把 have already merged 一個動詞片語拆在兩段，PERF 句型的得分取決於一個副詞。只寫 have merged（不寫 already）也是正確的完成式，卻會對不上第 3 部分。建議把「已經」併入第 4 部分（have already merged with nearby schools）。

problems: 第 2 題驗證者對4 部分切分有意見（warn）：第 3 部分「已經」只有兩個字，accepted 全部要求出現 already／now／recently；而 have 在第 3 部分、merged 在第 4 部分，把 have already merged 一個動詞片語拆在兩段，PERF
